flags.name: creature_day_stamp
flags.note: bits 0-6 = the day this creature was last spoken to (COME BACK TOMORROW while it equals today); bit 7 = its once-per-quest spirit gift is spent.  For ambushers bits 0-4 instead hold the time-of-day slot they settled in

milestones.what: Choose a character and pick up the shuba, the one food item and the three tokens lying in your own nid place.
milestones.verified: object table: every nid room holds one shuba, one food item and three tokens

milestones.what: Explore, SPEAK and PENSE widely; note which houses offer food or a nid, and where the shops are.
milestones.verified: gift-givers reset once per game day (creature_day_stamp)

milestones.what: Buy a trencher beak in the Broad Grund and cut your way to the Hermit at the top of the Grand Grund.  SPEAK: +5 spirit, vision 0.
milestones.verified: room 41, creature kind $40; room 38 sells trencher beaks

milestones.what: Reach the Child in the Garden in the small nid place on the right of the Garden Grund.  SPEAK: +5 spirit, vision 1.
Take a vine rope to the highest nid place in the Sky Grund, use it across a gap and CRAWL over.  REST in that nid; the next doorway puts you in the cloud world.
milestones.verified: REST in room 9 sets dream_state; the next door leads to room 190 and back

milestones.what: Walk up the clouds to D'ol Neshom.  SPEAK: +5 spirit, vision 2, and she offers the spirit bell -- TAKE it in room 191.  Leave by entering and leaving the nid place again.
milestones.verified: room 191 creature kind $40, gift item 0 (A SPIRIT BELL); the only spirit bell in the world is in room 191

milestones.what: Gather wissenberries, a token and as many honeylamps as you can carry.  Get to the surface below the Sky Grund.
milestones.verified: rooms 46 and 39 sell wissenberries and honeylamps

milestones.what: OFFER wissenberries to the outer gate guard twice -- the second offering unlocks that gate for good.  OFFER a token to the inner guard, which opens his door for this visit only.
milestones.verified: room 352 guard sets gate_352_open on the second berry; room 32 guard only ever sets the one-visit override

milestones.what: USE a honeylamp and work right and down through the caverns to Vatar.  SPEAK: +5 spirit, vision 3.
PENSE MESSAGES with five distinct animals.  The fifth gives the congratulation and vision 4.
SPEAK to Raamo's Mother in the Temple Grund for the clue about the spirit lamp (in code this is a fifth +5 blesser).
Get the temple key (hidden hole in the leftmost temple Grund) and, after speaking to D'ol Falla, D'ol Falla's key.  The second opens the forgotten chamber and the spirit lamp inside it.
milestones.verified: room 71 creature kind $D0 sets falla_key_revealed; the only spirit lamp is in room 75

milestones.what: Raise the spirit limit to 30 so you can kiniport your body; buy a spare shuba.
milestones.verified: skill thresholds at $401A/$4022; room 64 sells shubas

milestones.what: Go below the root with the spirit lamp (or a lit honeylamp) and the spirit bell, find Raamo near the Bottomless Lake, and OFFER him a shuba (a vine rope also works).
milestones.verified: OFFER to state index $49 accepts item 7 or item 11
